title: Image inputs now match model capabilities
summary:
A reliability-heavy day: clearer image-input rules, more room for slow requests, sturdier usage tracking, and error handlers that do not become the error.

Chat requests with images now get a clear 400 error when the selected model cannot accept them. Registry corrections also mark Perplexity Fast, Perplexity Reasoning, and Nova as image-capable, while removing image support claims from the OpenAI audio models.

The gateway no longer cuts off generic OpenAI and Portkey requests, image fetching for text requests, or Azure Flux Kontext safety checks at its former fixed time limits. AssemblyAI transcription polling now allows up to four minutes instead of two.

Model pricing now derives Pollen charges from one cost rate per model, preserving existing rates through overrides while changing Gemini Fast input-audio and Scribe hourly charges. Enter rounds displayed per-million prices to the nearest cent. Usage reports containing an unconfigured rate no longer stop the remaining rated usage from being tracked and charged.
